text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Got that right! But if you don't master it,
you'll
end up just like I did. I don't want
you quitting
before you've made it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's right. Ryan, you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I got pounded into the dirt! I wasn't
strong
enough back then, so that was
part of it too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (I understand. And I will never forget.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober and Ryan said they would come
to cheer
me on at the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Satsuki Sho. Mejiro
Bright's
eyes seem to wander.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you remember how
nonchalantly Ryan
spoke of her loss at
the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I believe she was concealing her real
feelings. On
that day, I was watching her
very carefully...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aaaaauggggh! Why? Why?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Grandmother! You had such
hopes
for me... since the day I was born!
You never once
gave up on me! So why
did I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: GWAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I didn't cry when watching her. I wanted
to, but I
opened my eyes wide instead
and listened closely
to her voice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's burned into my memory. I'll never
forget her
frustration, not until the day
that I wash it away in
her stead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And it's going to be
today—because I will
use what Ryan
taught me.
choice_data_list: A day to pour into something else...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
By running with the advice she's given
me, I
wanted to alleviate her pain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Most Umamusume have but one chance
at the
Triple Crown. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ryan has two... because I will run in her
place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I originally thought it was simply
coincidence that
we decided to rely on
Ryan's coaching, but it
seems Mejiro
Bright was being guided somehow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To avenge Mejiro Ryan's loss.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When I was very young, Ryan told me
something.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No one knows if you can run fast or not.
You're
not even grown up yet, so it's
way too early to
tell.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You don't have a thing to worry about.
Your
future is bright, and you'll get
there at your own
pace.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The way you run will be your own.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's why I chose to believe in myself
and run my
own way, because Ryan
placed her faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you believe... that I can shine
today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's. You've walked with me all this
time.
choice_data_list: You can shine! Let's do it—run your own race!
You can shine! Let's do it—with your own running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So let's win this race for her and finish
the day
with a smile.
